vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: tickerdb
Version: 0.1.3

The tickerdb skill is a legitimate integration for the TickerDB market intelligence service. It provides comprehensive instructions for an AI agent to perform authentication, query financial data (stocks, crypto, ETFs), manage watchlists, and set up automated market reports via cron jobs. The authentication flow is transparent, requiring user interaction for email verification, and all network activity is directed to the official api.tickerdb.com domain. No indicators of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or harmful prompt injection were found in SKILL.md or _meta.json.

llm.summary: The skill's requests and runtime instructions are coherent with its stated purpose (market-data queries) and only require the TICKERDB API key; nothing in the SKILL.md or metadata requests unrelated credentials or risky installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (querying TickerDB for categorical market intelligence) match the declared requirement (TICKERDB_KEY) and the SKILL.md instructions (calling api.tickerdb.com endpoints). No unrelated binaries, config paths, or extra credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions are focused on onboarding (collect email, verify code) and calling TickerDB endpoints (summary, search, watchlist). This is within scope, but the agent will collect the user's email and verification code and may display/save the returned API key; users should be aware that the skill instructs persistence of that key if they consent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec or code files — lowest-risk installation surface (nothing is written to disk by the skill itself).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only TICKERDB_KEY is required and declared as the primary credential. That is proportional and expected for an API-integration skill; no other secrets or unrelated env vars are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false (normal). The SKILL.md tells the agent to offer to save the returned API key and says OpenClaw will persist it automatically on confirmation — this is a platform capability, not an extra credential request by the skill, but users should consciously consent before storing their API key. The skill can be invoked autonomously by the agent (default behavior).
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent for accessing TickerDB data. Before installing, consider: (1) Only provide the TICKERDB_KEY (no other credentials). (2) The agent will ask for your email and verification code to obtain/verify the key — confirm you are comfortable sharing that during onboarding. (3) If offered, only allow the platform to persist your API key if you trust the environment; you can revoke the key at tickerdb.com if needed. (4) If you enable watchlist webhooks or daily reports, verify which callback URL the skill will use and ensure any webhook endpoints you provide are safe. If you want tighter control, decline automatic key storage and enter the key manually each session.
